title: OA MONSTERS - the Bajang, the lesser spirit: the stat block and the description
audit_comment: OA round ninety-two (capture pp. 253-254): the Chapter 12 monster roster opener - the Bajang (Lesser Spirit), the stat block and the description riding together, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA MONSTERS - THE BAJANG, printed capture pp. 253-254 - the lesser spirit round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE STAT BLOCK: the very rare, the 1 appearing, the AC 2, the move 12, the HD 6, the 20% lair, the treasure P, the 2 attacks of 1-4/1-4, the spells and the poison special attacks, the nil special defenses, the 10% magic resistance, the high intelligence, the chaotic evil, the size S, the V/500 + 6 per hp. THE DESCRIPTION: the evil and malignant tropical-jungle creature; the true form the stunted humanoid with bird-like feet and clawed hands; the wildcat shape at will, the most commonly seen appearance; the eight spells (the curse, the omen, the divination, the fate, the ghost light, the wind breath, the steam breath, the transfix) cast three times per day; the ancient curse once per day; the claw poison the -1 on all hit and saving throw rolls for the 2-7 rounds, cumulative; the spirit limitations; the tree lifeforce - the tree destroyed, the bajang instantly slain, the location concealed; the village predation by night, the victims taken sleeping; the evil sorcerer's familiar service; the intelligent and extremely devious temperament; the own language and the common area language. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus
